_comment: Source colour -> chosen Apollo step, for cases where nearest-colour crosses a ramp and produces mud. See docs/palette.md section 3. Every entry needs a 'why'; the loader rejects it otherwise. Added from the mapping report in Task 9, never pre-emptively.

overrides.why: the sprite outline. palette.md section 4 fixes it as the darkest blue and says every sprite uses the same one; nearest-colour puts pure black in Neutral at 090a14, which is the sooty black that decision exists to avoid
the oak trunk's outline, one shade off pure black. Same rule as 000000, and it has to make the same jump or the trunk would be outlined in a different colour from the canopy around it
oak trunk shadow landed in Gold at 341c27; palette.md section 4 puts trunks in Tan
oak trunk mid-tone landed in Gold at 602c2c; palette.md section 4 puts trunks in Tan, with 7a4841 as the base
the dark green of the grass tuft at the oak's base landed in Neutral at 151d28; a foliage colour outside the Green ramp is exactly the mud palette.md section 3 warns about
skin shading landed in Gold at de9e41 while the skin it shades landed in Tan at e7d5b3; palette.md section 3 forbids mixing ramps to make a shade, and this is 7% of every visible pixel in the project
